messages:
erin_support: FYI incoming ticket from AcmeApp — they started seeing p95 jump from ~120ms -> ~1.6s and p99 -> 3s on text-gen endpoints around 03:40 UTC. Customer says this started right after your batching rollout. ticket: #CUST-12345, sample request id req-abc123 :eyes:

grace_oncall: I'm on it. which model/region? can someone pull the per-pod tail metrics? :mag:

fay_obs: grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd - dashboard 'batcher: latency by pod' shows a sharp increase in batcher_wait_ms and token_hold_count since 03:40 for svc/model-prod-eu-west-1. alert fired: batcher_wait_ms_p95 > 200ms for 5m. logs: see snippet below.

fay_obs: ```
2026-03-12T03:41:12Z pod/model-prod-7 - INFO batcher: enqueued=6 wait_ms=48 max_hold=50
2026-03-12T03:41:12Z pod/model-prod-7 - INFO batcher: dispatch size=2 latency=120ms
2026-03-12T03:41:12Z pod/model-prod-7 - WARNING batcher: tiny-reqs starvation, hold_count=7
```

alice_sre: looks like hold-window jumped. Was there a config change rolled? @dan_platform any rollout events around 03:38-03:42?

deploy-bot: deploy event: continuous-batcher-config v2.7.0 rolled to model-prod-eu-west-1 at 03:36 UTC (strategy: canary -> 100% completed). commit: a1b2c3

ben_ml: I reviewed the config: default `hold_window_ms` was increased from 8 -> 50 in v2.7.0 to improve throughput on medium prompts. That helps throughput but hurts tiny prompts. We probably over-indexed the histogram used for decision.

alice_sre: okay, reproduce plan: 1) collect per-request trace for req-abc123 2) run short-prompt load generator 3) try quick mitigations (reduce hold_window, cap batch size, rollback canary). grabbing traces now.

alice_sre: command to fetch logs for req id: `kubectl logs -l app=model-prod -c runtime --since=10m | grep req-abc123 -n`

ben_ml: prometheus queries that helped me: `rate(batcher_wait_ms_bucket[5m])` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batcher_wait_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, pod))` also `sum(rate(token_hold_count[5m])) by (pod)`.

alice_sre: quick repro script for tiny prompts (run from tools-host):

alice_sre: ```python
import requests, time
url = 'https://api.redwood/internal/v1/generate'
for i in range(1000):
    r = requests.post(url, json={'model':'model-prod','prompt':'hi','max_tokens':5})
    print(i, r.status_code, r.elapsed.total_seconds())
    time.sleep(0.01)
```

ben_ml: ran a local run against canary; observed p95 ~ 1.4s when hold_window_ms=50 and max_batch_size=64, p95 drops to ~160ms when hold_window_ms=8 and max_batch_size=8.

fay_obs: added a quick alert suppression for the customer to avoid noisy alerts while debugging.

dan_platform: mitigation options (fast):
- roll config back to previous hold_window_ms=8 (immediate, atomic)
- patch v2.7.1 to set hold_window_ms to auto-tune based on prompt length histogram
- temporary route AcmeApp to small-batcher pool (lower latency)

alice_sre: I'm going to try a live patch to reduce hold_window for model-prod-eu-west-1 to 10ms and cap max_batch_size to 12 on the affected nodes. will monitor p95 for 10m.

cara_ce: I'll message AcmeApp with a short status: "we're investigating tail latency, temporary config change in progress, will advise within 20m".

grace_oncall: go ahead with the live patch. if we don't see improvements in 10m, roll back the entire v2.7.0. Also capture flame graphs for those pods.

alice_sre: patch applied on pods: `kubectl apply -f patch-batcher-hold-10ms.yaml` -> patch rolled to 6/6 pods at 03:53 UTC.

fay_obs: metric update: p95 for model-prod-eu-west-1 dropped from 1.6s -> 170ms within 90s after patch. token_hold_count decreased. grafana link: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd?from=03:45&to=04:00

ben_ml: confirmed on canary too. we should change the canary strategy for config rollouts to %age gradual steps, and add a short-prompt workload test in CI.

alice_sre: followups: - create revert PR for v2.7.0 -> v2.6.x defaults (hold_window=8,max_batch_size=16) - add a perf test in merge gate that simulates tiny prompts - add a metric `short_prompt_ratio` to auto-tune hold window

dan_platform: filing infra ticket INFRA-789 to add staged rollout guard and a smoke test job.

cara_ce: sent customer message: "we rolled a mitigation and are monitoring — p95 back within expected range; we will follow up with postmortem and config change plan" :thumbsup:

fay_obs: I'll attach the trace and flamegraph to the ticket.

alice_sre: recording thread notes: cause = continuous-batcher hold_window increase in config v2.7.0; effect = tiny-prompt starvation and tail-latency spike; mitigation = live patch reduce hold_window + cap batch size + route fallback; long-term = CI tiny-prompt perf test + canary gating + auto-tuning.

grace_oncall: nice work. closing alert but keep monitoring for 2h. add postmortem entry when available. :white_check_mark:

cara_ce: customer confirmed latency improved and will reopen if they see regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy event: v2.7.1 (rollback defaults) queued; PR: https://git.internal/p/r/987

alice_sre: assigning action items: @ben_ml add tiny-prompt test (due EOD), @dan_platform add staged rollout guard (due tomorrow), @fay_obs attach traces to ticket, @cara_ce update customer with postmortem draft. I'll draft the postmortem after we collect CI data.

ben_ml: ack, started local branch for the test.

grace_oncall: last check: no more p95 alerts for 12m, leaving in observation window. thanks everyone.

cara_ce: marking ticket CUST-12345 resolved for now.

alice_sre: thanks team.
